summary: Verified new /widget.js loader deliverable + embed bridge alongside preserved widget UX. Static widget.js served with 200 and contains all required tokens. On /widget-demo.html iframe is exactly 148x148 when closed, grows to 448x728 after clicking the trigger (with 220ms transition), and shrinks back to 148x148 after clicking pinky-close-button. Parent receives {source:'pinky-agent', type:'READY'} plus RESIZE messages with correct {w,h} payloads. Iframe does NOT block clicks on parent page elements (verified by clicking <h2 id='about'> and confirming the parent-side click handler fires). Duplicate /widget.js injection is idempotent (only one #pinky-agent-iframe exists). /?embed=1 tags <body> with pinky-embedded; top-window / (no embed param, not iframed) does NOT tag body. Core widget behavior preserved: 'Show me your CV' prompt still surfaces the 'Open Resume' tool bubble.
critical_code_review_comments: widget.js: iframe has no explicit sandbox or allow-scripts restrictions; acceptable for same-origin embed but Framer/cross-origin parents should be aware.

widget.js message router filters by event.origin === WIDGET_ORIGIN which is correct, but there is no guard on payload URL schemes for OPEN_EXTERNAL / OPEN_PROJECT before window.location.href = ... — a malicious widget origin could still navigate parent to javascript: URLs. Consider validating that absolutize() only allows http/https protocols before goto().
Trigger button in AgentPanel lacks a dedicated data-testid='pinky-agent-trigger' (only bare <button> found) — adding one would improve test stability.
widget-demo.html loads Tailwind via CDN (warning in console) — fine for demo but note it is not production-appropriate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget loader + resize bridge fully verified against deployment URL. Message sequence observed at parent: READY -> RESIZE(148,148) -> RESIZE(448,728) on open -> RESIZE(148,148) on close. Trigger button in iframe is the first <button> (no explicit testid); close uses data-testid='pinky-close-button'. Panel element has data-testid='pinky-agent-panel'. If you need to close an empty-transcript conversation quickly, pinky-close-button triggers close without confirmation modal.
